title: User Onboarding Flow
body:
### Who downloads Zapstore

- **Camp A — Zapstore-first:** They want Zapstore itself (browse, install, use the client).
- **Camp B — Another-app-first:** They installed Zapstore mainly to resolve something outside Zapstore immediately (typically via a QR/code path for another app or link-style flow).

### Welcome panel

On first launch, a **dismissible panel** isn’t defining those camps—it just offers these two obvious actions:

1. **Set up profile** (social / identity in Zapstore)
2. **Scan QR/code** (other apps, invites, storefront-style links—especially important if you’re Camp B)

Either camp can dismiss the panel, or pick whichever action they need first.

### Profile-setup flow

We first publish a **small profile** with essentially **display name (+ PoW)** so our relay can whitelist the user’s pubkey (for media uploads, forum posts, comments, ...). 

After that, a **proper profile-edit screen** (photo + fuller metadata) can update the identity. Since now the pubkey is whitelisted for those media uploads.

| Step | What the user does | What the app quietly does |
|------|---------------------|---------------------------|
| 1 | Starts profile setup | Opens the steps without freezing the UI. |
| 2 | **Name modal:** types a display name • can optionally bring an existing key instead | Existing-key folks follow a different shortcut; assume “new profile” onward here. |
| 3 | **Spin-key modal:** slot machine Ui that spins up nsec for user. Auto-opens next modal on finish. | **`nsec` already exists before the spin.** While the user fiddles—or anytime after— **`proof-of-work grinds steadily in the background`**, costing nothing to taps. More PoW time = nicer later publish. Never block buttons on mining. |
| 4 | **Key explanation screen:** lays out what key is and how user can store/use it| Keeps hashing **proof-of-work in the background**|
| 5 | Taps Continue into **finish / edit profile** (photo & profile extras) | Once they land here, **`publish minimal profile with accumulated proof-of-work`**. Goal: relays **whitelist** them |
| 6 | Saves extras (photo, richer fields) later | Treat as **overwrite / refresh** atop the minimal profile, now with media etc... for which they were whitelisted with first profile event. |

title: [Feature Request] Support "light mode" theme
body:
